title: The Weather of the old quarter
author: Lena Delacroix
blurb: Jonah Underhill, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
